name: New Balance Tekela V5 Elite Low Laced FG

description.subtitle: New Balance FG football boots for natural or artificial grass of the latest generation - blue
description.intro: The New Balance Tekela V5 Elite FG are designed for footballers who dominate the game’s pace. Thanks to its anatomical fit, technical materials and a touch-optimized surface, these boots raise your control to another level. Perfect for creative midfielders and game-vision players.
key_benefits: Upper Control: Advanced surface that improves the precision of the pass and touch.
High performance adjustment: Structure that wraps the foot like a second skin.
Total stability: Optimized distribution of tacos for balance in each action.
Professional design: Premium materials and technical construction.
Highlighting Style: Blue color with aggressive details to stand out in the field.
